Round138E.genuine_strip_remainder_three_blocks.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K] (alpha R : ℝ)
  (phi : G → ℂ) (hsupp : ∀ (g : G), phi g ≠ 0 → |ell g| ≤ R) (x y : G) :
  stripRemainder K alpha phi x y =
    slabExp K alpha R abs x * phi (x * y⁻¹) * slabExp K (-alpha) R abs y -
      if 0 ≤ ell x then slabExp K alpha R id x * phi (x * y⁻¹) * slabExp K (-alpha) R id y
      else slabExp K (-alpha) R id x * phi (x * y⁻¹) * slabExp K alpha R id y
